subject: Freight claim 2026-0188 - damaged pallets, load 2208871
text:
Hello,

We have received your claim for 2 damaged pallets on load 2208871 (BOL 2208871, delivered 10/30). Claim value stated: $1,980.00. Please send photos of the damage and the original packing list within 30 days so we can process it with our cargo carrier.

Please do not deduct the claim amount from open invoices until the claim is resolved.

Cobalt Freight Claims
